response.overview: Former professional climber and elite mountain runner Shane Ohly attempts the unimaginable, to conquer the Dragon’s Back Race® in a single, non-stop push. Spanning 380km from Conwy to Cardiff, this iconic Welsh challenge is typically completed over six days. Supported only by a dedicated crew of friends, Shane’s journey is an extraordinary test of physical and mental endurance.
response.title: Y Ddraig
